messages.subject: ggplot boxplot not shwoing colour
parts:
i am trying to get multicoloured boxplot . I followed instruction given at http://www.cookbook-r.com/Graphs/Axes_(ggplot2)/#setting-and-hiding-tick-markers for getting colours in boxplot.

cbPalette <- c("#999999", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7","#999999", "#E69F00")

controlt1 <- ggplot(x, aes(x=Subgroup, y=Expression)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_fill_manual(values=cbPalette)

still i  am getting whilte box plot 

My second query is , having input file of more than 40000 entries , i am getting box plot which is not clear . Is there any way to fix the yaxis window. 

waiting for reply

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: ggplot boxplot not shwoing colour
parts:
You need to map something to fill, e.i.,

ggplot(x, aes(x=Subgroup, y=Expression, fill=<the_fill_variable>) ...

You can limit the y axis, see ?scale_y_continuous and ?coord_cartesian

Best,
Ista
